# Post-Review Approval

Use this after review and before sync/archive.

```md
## Human Approval

- Change: <change-name>
- Approval type: post-review
- Decision: approved | rejected | changes-requested
- Approver: <approver>
- Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Review accepted: yes | no
- Checks accepted: yes | no
- Documentation synchronized: yes | no
- Archive decision: archive | keep-open | defer
- Notes: <optional>
```

Archive or close only when `Decision` is `approved`.
